text:
Ivy: kicking off a quarterly recurring-incident synthesis thread. goal: distill top recurring causes, own remediations, set hard deadlines.
Marco: pulled last 16 PMs, common clusters: cache invalidations, memory regressions after model updates, and deployment rollback failures due to config drift.
Hannah: agree on clusters. can we scope to top 3 for a focused sprint? we risk spread-thin fixes.
Kofi: propose top3 = cache invalidation (KV eviction TTL bug), model memory spikes (recent quantize/flag regressions), and rollback failures (missing schema checks).
Ivy: owners? Kofi for model memory, Marco for cache, Hannah for rollback tooling. set dates pls.
Kofi: I'll own memory work. quick mitigations: enforce per-request token cap + OOM sandbox by 4/02. longer: perf harness + regression CI by 5/10.
Marco: cache owner. plan: reproduce eviction with prefix churn by 3/29, PR 4/07, canary 4/14.
Hannah: rollback tooling owner. short-term: add preflight schema validation and auto-rollback gate by 3/26. long-term: immutable deployment manifests by 5/01.
IncidentBot: please add these to the tracker: https://go.redwood/incident-tracker and label sprint=recurring-fixes.
Ivy: add risk levels in tracker and list cross-team deps (eng-infra for staging capacity, eng-sre for runbooks).
Marco: note: cache change may invalidate prefetched items; risk=medium. will include smoke tests.
Kofi: memory mitigations may slightly raise latency for large contexts; documenting customer impact in tracker.
Hannah: will draft rollback runbook + rollback test harness by 3/30.
Ivy: weekly updates required. I'll present a one-slide summary for leadership after the sprint ends. reconvene in 2 weeks.
